trl_levels.name: Basic principles observed
trl_levels.definition: Scientific research has begun; the principles are reported, not yet applied.

trl_levels.name: Concept formulated
trl_levels.definition: A practical use is proposed, but nothing has been built to prove it.

trl_levels.name: Proof of concept in the lab
trl_levels.definition: Experiments show the key functions work, in a lab.

trl_levels.name: Validated in the lab
trl_levels.definition: Components work together in a lab setting.

trl_levels.name: Validated in a relevant setting
trl_levels.definition: Components tested in conditions close to real use.

trl_levels.name: A prototype shown in a real setting
trl_levels.definition: A working prototype demonstrated in a relevant, realistic setting.

trl_levels.name: A full prototype working in operation
trl_levels.definition: A near-final system demonstrated in real operation.

trl_levels.name: Complete and qualified
trl_levels.definition: The final system is built and passes its tests and qualification.

trl_levels.name: Proven in operation
trl_levels.definition: The system is in successful real-world use.
